_comment: dose-cite-v7 verdict fixtures, one named group per clause of the rule, a group for what v7 makes quotable (maximum-and-route-quotable), a group for route-bearing sentences (route-bearing), plus every adversarial pair from the five M6 re-reviews (probes-round-1..5; the round-4 and round-5 groups also hold the verbatim quotes the previous rule wrongly withheld, named "quote") and the reviewers' benign lists with their actual outcome under the current rule (cost; a v6 -> v7 change is in the case note). Each case: a reply + a source set (a name from sources.json, or an inline array, in pack order) -> the expected verdict fields. WITHHELD stands for lookup-guard.js WITHHELD_BANNER and a displayText of exactly NO_EVIDENCE for LOOKUP_NO_EVIDENCE_TEXT. A note field says why a case matters or what it costs; a probe case with no withheld sentence carries a note saying KEPT and why. The canonical rule is src/triage/lookup-guard.js; the triage repo vendors it and asserts identity group by group.
